comments.quote: 我在攜程上定的是能看日出，能看日落，能看山景，能看夜景的房間。每天房價1900多。很失望，能看到的衹有樹🌴🌴🌴🌴把能看到的景全擋住。早餐也不好，能吃的就是麪條和餛飩。説是有中西餐搭配，能吃的蛋糕和點心也是衹有3種。牛奶也不熱。我住了兩晚，在酒店交的第二天的錢。要求給換個房間，酒店也拒絕了，總得體驗太糟心。説是送30分鐘免費拍照，送三張免費照片，多加一張收費￥80。酒店還有送當地人導遊帶領遊山，這裏也是坑，有額外收費的，要去的遊人小心上當。攜程下回推薦要實事求是，這回酒店的體驗不是很好，網上看到的是5分，在我這裏也衹能給到4.5分。住的還好，服務員也不錯。就是酒店前台給我的印象不好，男男女女的前後説不到一起，各説個話。房價電視也小，頻道還少。跟網評相差較遠。我們經常出門自駕遊，跟去過的地方比較，這裏不達標。我的拍照片裏是房間能看到風景的窗户和陽台，都讓樹🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴🌴檔得嚴實😇😇😇我定的房價是要求看日出🌄日落🌅風景，都不達標，不達標！與房價相比，不達標！！！

comments.quoteEn: I booked a room advertised for sunrise, sunset, mountain views and night views, at over 1,900 a night. Very disappointing. All you can see is trees, which block the lot. Breakfast was poor too, essentially noodles and wonton. It is billed as Chinese and Western, and there were only three kinds of cake and pastry you could eat. The milk was not hot. I stayed two nights, paying for the second at the hotel, and asked to change rooms, which they refused. The stay was thoroughly disheartening. Thirty minutes of free photography was promised with three free photographs, and each extra one costs 80. There is also a local guide for the mountain, another trap, with charges on top, so visitors should be careful. Recommendations on the platform should be honest. This place is rated five and from me it gets four and a half at most. The room was fine and the staff were fine. The front desk left a poor impression, with nobody saying the same thing. The television is small and there are few channels. It is a fair way off its reviews. We drive and travel often, and compared with everywhere we have been, this does not meet the standard. My photographs show the window and balcony the views are supposed to be from, and the trees block them completely. I booked for sunrise and sunset and it does not meet the standard, not for that price.
